definitions: A cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky either as an indistinct bright patch or as a dark silhouette against other luminous matter.
A galaxy, especially one other than the Milky Way.
A cloudy appearance in a person's urine.
A cloudy spot on the cornea of the eye.
examples: The Orion Nebula is a well-known example.
Many nebulae are visible through telescopes.
The doctor noted a nebula in the patient's urine sample.
A nebula on the cornea can impair vision.
